functions.name: AddMeasuredCallEvent
documentation: Adds a measured event to any ongoing measured calls. If no such calls are currently taking place, this function does nothing.

arguments.name: name
documentation: User-defined string describing the measured event. This should be kept under 48 bytes to avoid memory allocations.

functions.name: AddPerformanceMessageShown
documentation: Internal API for telemetry.

functions.name: CheckForPerformanceMessage
documentation: Optimized check for determining if AddOns are severely impacting UI performance.

functions.name: GetAddOnMetric
documentation: Gets an AddOn profiler value - all times returned are in milliseconds.

functions.name: GetApplicationMetric
documentation: Overall profiling data for the entire application (not just the UI)

functions.name: GetOverallMetric
documentation: Overall profiling data for all addons

functions.name: GetTicksPerSecond
documentation: Returns the number of profiling clock ticks that occur within a single real-time second.

functions.name: GetTopKAddOnsForMetric
documentation: Gets top K AddOns for a given metric.

functions.name: IsEnabled
documentation: AddOn profiler will be enabled for all users, but this will return false if it ever isn't

functions.name: MeasureCall
documentation: Performs a profiled measurement of a single function call with any supplied arguments.

fields.name: name
documentation: User-defined string describing the measured event.

fields.name: allocatedBytes
documentation: Snapshot of the allocated byte count when this event was recorded.

fields.name: deallocatedBytes
documentation: Snapshot of the deallocated byte count when this event was recorded.

fields.name: elapsedMilliseconds
documentation: Snapshot of the elapsed milliseconds when this event was recorded.

fields.name: elapsedTicks
documentation: Snapshot of the elapsed tick count when this event was recorded.

fields.name: elapsedMilliseconds
documentation: Total number of milliseconds spent executing the function.

fields.name: elapsedTicks
documentation: Total number of profiling clock ticks spent executing the function.

fields.name: allocatedBytes
documentation: Total number of bytes allocated during call execution.

fields.name: deallocatedBytes
documentation: Total number of bytes deallocated during call execution.

fields.name: events
documentation: Events recorded by any AddMeasuredCallEvent calls that took place during function execution.
